fact: The DCI brief says Uganda has adopted a centralised architecture with a data exchange platform as the hub connecting different systems and routing their traffic.

A NITA-U IT professional said on 2026-10-01 that UGHub, a national data integration platform managed by NITA-U, connects NIRA's identity registry to MDAs and private institutions, which verify identities against it in real time.
The same NITA-U speaker said UGHub connects NIRA's registry with more than 150 government ministries, departments and agencies, plus banks and telecoms.

NITA-U's executive director said at the strategic plan launch that the UGHub data integration platform currently connects 37 percent of MDAs, with a target of 73 percent by FY 2029/30; the document gives no count of entities.
NITA-U stated at the 16 June 2026 launch of its strategic plan that UGHub currently connects 37 percent of MDAs, targeted to reach 73 percent by FY 2029/30; no count of entities is given.
NITA-U's UGHub page states the integration platform is fully operational, connecting government systems for real-time data sharing; dated by the page's 2025-06-19 publication.
The page states UGHub is fully operational and serves over 150 entities, with others onboarding; dated by page publication 2025-06-19.
NITA-U reports that through the Government interoperability platform, 168 organisations securely exchange information.
NITA-U reports 168 organisations, 70 public institutions and 98 private sector entities, exchange information through the Government interoperability platform.
